exposure: amnioinfusion in the presence of suspected intra-amniotic infections (SII)
cohort: The study included all consecutive singleton term deliveries with suspected intra-amniotic infections (SII) at a tertiary medical center between 2011 and 2019.
finding: The use of amnioinfusion for alleviating non-reassuring fetal heart rate in the presence of SII was found to be safe and did not increase the rate of maternal adverse outcomes.
